items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I worked with him and recorded. I did a recording session with him.

ctx.x: That’s right, [Lennie] Tristano. I worked with him and recorded. I did a recording session with him. I got that gig through Jimmy Jones. He had called me and said he’s looking for a bass player and that would be a good – and then he knew me, though working – yeah. This is after Shearing, because I had worked with Shearing, I think. This doesn’t come before. This comes . . .
So here you are. You’ve left Billie, arguably the top female jazz artist. You’re now trying to regroup. You’re in Chicago. You go straight to . . .
